next_candidate.rejection_rule: Reject before full benchmark if the design cannot plausibly remove at least 17386.570 ms decode time while adding less than 1642.887 ms overhead, or if top1 correctness cannot be guaranteed.
required_before_source_edit: Inspect active CPU fallback path and produce a dot-vs-source/page split for up/down fallback.
Write a source-level design that preserves logits/top1 and explains how new overhead stays below about 1.64s.
Run fixed-text sequential top1 verifier before any strict cold France token-rate benchmark.
next_candidate.why: It is the only remaining non-speculative class whose ideal bound exceeds 10 tok/s. All partial/offload/source-only paths are below 10 or already rejected.

target.interpretation: To reach 10 tok/s on the same output length, the accepted decode window must shrink by about 17.39s. Ideal full decode up/down fallback removal saves about 19.03s, leaving only about 1.64s for all new overhead.
